outputs.voiced_fraction: Share of voiced frames in the frames analysed (0–1)

trim_silence.description: Trim silence before the first and after the last voiced frame (SWIPE, F0 settings): phonation (phonation task only), always, never. Not applied with VAD

trim_margin.description: Margin kept before and after the voice when trimming (s)

frames.description: Frames the summary is computed from: voiced (by SWIPE) or all (every speech frame, version 1.2)

timestep.description: Frame step of the voicing tracker (s)

strength_threshold.description: Minimum SWIPE pitch strength below which a frame is unvoiced

drop_bounds.description: Treat frames where SWIPE hit f_min or f_max as unvoiced

min_voiced_seconds.description: Minimum total of voiced frames (s); below it nothing is reported and the reason goes to notes

time_smoothing.description: Filter order for averaging cepstra over time (CPPS only)

quefrency_smoothing.description: Filter order for smoothing along quefrency (CPPS only)

f0_min.description: Lowest F0 searched (Hz), upper quefrency bound; legacy 55

f0_max.description: Highest F0 searched (Hz), lower quefrency bound; legacy 500

search_offset.description: Offset of the peak search start past the lower quefrency bound (s); legacy 0.001

trend_min_q.description: Start of the trend-line regression range (s of quefrency); 0 = the search range

trend_max_q.description: End of the trend-line regression range (s of quefrency); 0 = the search range

aggregate.description: Summary across frames: median as in the legacy script, mean as in Praat and Hillenbrand (comparable with published norms)
